title: MK0 benchtop single-cell EHD thruster and 5-stage CW multiplier, 22 kV

provenance.origin: Generated from the MK0 defaults previously hardcoded in physics.DesignParameters and spice.SpiceParams, which reproduced the original sanity-check script exactly.
provenance.supersedes: physics.DesignParameters defaults, spice.SpiceParams defaults, and the 'cap = 1n' literal in the generated netlist text.
provenance.basis_note: Every field is 'claimed'. A design choice is an assertion until the built article is measured, and the environment fields are literature values. Low-water-mark therefore makes every quantity derived from this profile 'claimed' -- one tier below the 'analytical-placeholder' recorded in the MK0 BreadCrumb retrospective, which modelled the provenance of the formulas and not of the inputs. The lower ceiling is the correct figure.
provenance.measured_fields: None. No field has been measured on hardware. When one is, its basis becomes 'measured' and the ceiling rises only for quantities not descending from the remaining claimed inputs.

r_wire_m.note: 25 um tungsten, read as a RADIUS. Both readings exist in this project's source material; as a diameter V_onset would be 1.63 kV rather than 2.74 kV.

m_rough_factor.note: 0.8 for practical drawn wire, not 1.0 polished.

delta_air_density.note: Sea-level standard air assumed; not measured.

mu_ion_m2_per_Vs.note: Literature value for positive ions in air. Unverified in this apparatus.

N_stages.note: Droop grows as N^3: 445.5 V at N=5, ~1.74 kV at N=8.

L_r_H.note: Also carries transformer primary leakage in this lumped model.

L_m_H.note: Lm/Lr ~ 5 here; an LLC typically wants 3-10.

L_sec_H.note: Derived as L_m_H * turns_ratio_sec_per_pri^2. This was a 0.0 sentinel in SpiceParams; an explicit null cannot be mistaken for a real inductance.

k_coupling.note: Remaining leakage is lumped into L_r_H.

C_sec_F.note: HF HV windings on a PQ26/20 show tens of pF.
